modules.intro: Collect relevant papers each month from whitelisted sources registered for the domain. Produce and hand off outputs separately for each domain; source listings are shared across domains.
After conduct_survey, audit the collection results and judge whether they can be used for subsequent analysis.
After the collection results pass audit_survey, analyze research trends and gaps in the monthly literature and propose Idea sparks for use by develop_idea.
After analyze_trends, audit the trend report and judge whether it can be used by develop_idea.

Handle the paper download tasks in artifacts/paper_downloads/ (tasks for monthly surveys are under the domain directory, project tasks at the top level), saving PDFs to the directory that initiated the task.

Study published papers and record experience for forest-building behaviors per the playbook rules. Cold start files the paper into the literature forest; warm start additionally adopts the paper as a reproduction project to test the original claims, and summarizes the reproduction conclusions after the project's verdicts are complete.

In the literature forest, consolidate paper claims into high-level hypotheses, counterpart to consolidate_forest; warm start additionally adopts selected high-level hypotheses as consolidation projects in the real forest and verifies them hands-on.
For a hypothesis in the literature forest, select from papers published afterward an experiment that can test it and make a prediction, counterpart to test_hypothesis.
Judge whether the predictions in the literature forest match the results reported by the papers, counterpart to audit_tree.
Manage the playbooks of the various forest-building behaviors so that they reach the goals of each behavior in the playbook.

From the spark selected at launch, develop in batch multiple Ideas with non-overlapping directions, or revise existing Ideas, and hand them to review_idea; after review passes, the lead decides whether to adopt.
Independently review the Ideas produced by develop_idea; the purpose is to improve, not to screen.
Build a hypothesis tree from an Idea, high-level hypothesis, revision hypothesis or original claim, and adjust hypotheses according to verdicts.
Produce experimental evidence for the leaf hypotheses in the hypothesis tree.
Judge whether the evidence supports the hypothesis and whether the hypothesis holds.
Consolidate multiple concrete hypotheses in the forest into a more concise high-level hypothesis and adopt it as a consolidation project for verification; once passed, it becomes a spark candidate.
Synthesize the project's research, design an attractive paper story, and determine the main thesis, submission target and outline.
Taking over the narrative line of the reviewed outline, complete a full set of informative, clearly expressed and attractive figures.
Following the narrative line of the reviewed outline and figure set, complete a paper with a complete story, substantial content and conformity to the expression conventions of the target venue.
Independently audit the writing quality of the specified version this time.
以目标刊会审稿人的视角审阅论文最新版本，判定科学上能否投稿，不能时给出修改意见。
Revise the paper according to review comments and reply point by point; when new evidence is needed, supplement the research through a revision project.
读懂科学审稿通过或用户裁定投稿的论文，用自己的话重新讲一遍，形成供编辑审稿的新版本。
以目标刊会编辑的视角独立审阅编辑稿能否抓住读者。

Prepare the paper that the user approved for submission into a submission or revision directly submittable to the target venue, track deadline and notification dates, serve until the user clicks the final submit, and record until the venue's result returns.

Track the deadlines and related dates of conferences, journals and their special issues in the whitelist; those not yet announced are estimated from previous editions, for reference in venue selection and submission planning.
Keep repository links, file placement, status markers, tools and module rules intact and consistent, and handle the workbench’s requests for repository changes.
Keep the workbench (the front end outside the project) up to date with the project's current conventions, usable and complete in Chinese and English.

roles.duty: Maintain the project architecture, module rules, tools and interfaces, keeping responsibilities and artifact conventions consistent.
Choose research directions, make Ideas concrete, decompose hypotheses and determine the research plan, and decide priorities, advancement and adjustment.
Synthesize literature and experimental results, analyze trends, propose Idea sparks, interpret results and organize research argumentation.
Complete well-scoped retrieval, screening, extraction and organization of materials, preserving sources and uncertainty.
Implement the research plan, process data, run experiments, produce experimental result figures and tables, and ensure reproducibility.

Synthesize the project's existing research, autonomously determine the paper's main thesis and submission target, design the narrative line, organize the outline, figure set and full text, and prepare the submission materials.
Independently review the specified artifact per this module's requirements and identify issues affecting passing;
Manage the playbooks for the various forest-building behaviors so that experience genuinely improves subsequent behavior and achieves the goals of each behavior.
